;Armed conflicts and attacks
*[[Syrian Civil War]]
**[[Battle of Deir ez-Zor (September–November 2017)|Battle of Deir ez-Zor]]
***According to the [[Syrian Observatory for Human Rights]], the city of [[Deir ez-Zor]] has largely been cleared of [[ISIS]] fighters by the [[Syrian Armed Forces]]. Deir ez-Zor was the scene of a [[Siege of Deir ez-Zor (2014–17)|three-year-long siege]] until it was broken in September 2017. [https://www.theguardian.com/world/2017/nov/02/deir-ez-zor-cleared-of-last-islamic-state-fighters-isis (''The Guardian'')]

;Arts and culture
*[[Balfour Declaration]]
**A [[Bethlehem]] art installation (by anonymous artist [[Banksy]]) satirizes the 100th anniversary of the [[Balfour Declaration]]. [https://www.theguardian.com/world/2017/nov/01/palestinians-crash-banksy-street-party-seeking-apology-for-balfour-declaration (''The Guardian'')]

;Business and economy
*[[First presidency of Donald Trump|Presidency of Donald Trump]]
**[[Donald Trump]] nominates [[Jerome Powell]] to be the next chairman of the [[Chair of the Federal Reserve]]. [http://abcnews.go.com/Politics/trump-nominates-jerome-powell-federal-reserve-chair/story?id=50868247 (ABC News)]

;Disasters and accidents
*[[2017 NTPC power plant explosion]]
**At least 22 people killed and 100 injured in boiler explosion at a [[coal-fired power plant]] in Uttar Pradesh state, India. [https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/world-asia-41835372 (BBC)]
*At least eighteen Malawian soldiers are killed after a truck left the road at a corner and rolled over in [[Mzimba]], [[Malawi]]. [https://www.independent.co.ug/18-soldiers-killed-malawi-road-accident/ (The Independent)]

;Law and crime
*[[Spanish constitutional crisis]]
**Judge Lamela sends preventive detention to eight of the ministers of the [[Puigdemont Government|Government of Catalonia]] ([[Oriol Junqueras|Junqueras]], [[Joaquim Forn|Forn]], [[Meritxell Borràs|Borràs]], [[Raül Romeva|Romeva]], [[Carles Mundó|Mundó]], [[Dolors Bassa|Bassa]], [[Josep Rull|Rull]], [[Jordi Turull|Turull]]) due to an alleged crime of sedition and rebellion. The ninth [[Santi Vila]], minister of Enterprise and Knowledge, leaves the jail the next day after payment of a bail, being the only one who was given this opportunity. [https://www.bbc.com/news/world-europe-41850094 (BBC)]
**Five other members of the [[Board of the Parliament of Catalonia#Eleventh Parliament|Bureau]] of the Parliament and the [[Speaker of the Parliament of Catalonia|Speaker]] face similar charges, but each case will be handled by  the [[Supreme Court of Spain|Supreme Court]] due to their parliamentary immunity. [https://www.bbc.com/news/world-europe-41850094 (BBC)]
**A new general strike is convened in Catalonia for November 8. [http://www.express.co.uk/news/world/863889/catalonia-referendum-independence-european-union-spain (''Express'')]

;Politics and elections
*[[Icelandic parliamentary election, 2017]]
**Opposition leader [[Katrín Jakobsdóttir]] of the [[Left-Green Movement]] receives the mandate to form a government with its coalition partners: the [[Social Democratic Alliance]], the [[Progressive Party (Iceland)|Progressive]]s and the [[Pirate Party (Iceland)|Pirate]]s. [https://www.bloomberg.com/news/articles/2017-11-02/iceland-leftist-gets-mandate-to-explore-ruling-coalition (Bloomberg)]
*[[Donald Trump on social media]]
**U.S. President [[Donald Trump]]'s main social media account is suspended for 11 minutes. [[Twitter]] blames the incident on an employee and says it is "taking steps to prevent this from happening again." [https://www.theguardian.com/us-news/2017/nov/02/trump-twitter-account-offline (''The Guardian'')]

;Science and technology
*The [[Tapanuli orangutan]] is identified as a new [[species]] of [[great ape]]. [https://www.theguardian.com/science/2017/nov/02/new-species-of-orangutan-discovered-in-northern-sumatra-tapanuli-pongo-tapanuliensis (''The Guardian'')]
